caption: The drawing features a ceramic or porcelain cat figurine positioned in the center of a plain beige or light tan background. The cat is depicted sitting upright with its body facing forward and its head turned slightly to its left. The figurine is predominantly a pale grayish-white color. The inside of the ears are tinted with a reddish-pink color. The eyes are round and outlined in black, with the pupils indicated by small dark dots and additional black and pink markings around them. The nose and mouth are illustrated with black lines, and there is a red mark near the mouth, possibly representing a tongue or a painted detail. The cat’s tail is curled around its right side in the foreground and is colored black. The figurine sits on a base that appears to be shaped and shaded to suggest a flat, slightly uneven surface, rendered in shades of light brown, green, and gray. The rest of the image contains no other objects or significant detail, with some faint pencil signatures or notes near the bottom edge.
title: Pa. German Seated Cat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
